file_roles.evidence: QLibraryPrivate::load() no longer wraps load_sys() in mutex.lock()/unlock(); holding it across dlopen caused the recursive deadlock.
load_sys takes QMutexLocker only for setup and does locker.unlock() before dlopen, then relock() for the result.
Same pattern in Windows load_sys: lock released around LoadLibrary and relocked after.

rationale: Stack trace shows updatePluginState waiting on the mutex held by load_sys during dlopen, whose init code recurses. The three files together change the lock scope so it is not held across dlopen.
